access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Nphies grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

list.title: Authorizations
list.subtitle: Every prior authorization raised, newest first. The window below is what you are looking at — remove it to see everything.
list.verdictBlank: No verdict yet — the payer has not answered.

window.removed: No date window — showing every authorization on record

markers.none: Nothing to flag on this authorization.
markers.payerQueryHint: The payer has asked a question about this authorization. Answering one is not available here — open the till application to reply.
markers.dispensedHint: This authorization has been dispensed at a till. It has reached the end of its life.

empty.title: No authorizations match
empty.hint: Nothing on record matches these filters.
empty.hintWindowed: Nothing matches these filters inside the date window above. Widen it or remove it to look further back.

acts.incomplete: Some acts could not be listed for this authorization.
acts.inFlight: Asking the exchange: {{act}} on {{reference}}. No other act can be started until this one answers.

hint.statusCheck: Ask the exchange where this request has got to. The service already polls every 15 seconds — press this when a request has waited longer than it should.
hint.retry: Ask again with the same request, and take the newer answer.
hint.cancel: Withdraw this authorization with the payer. This cannot be undone.
hint.openRefusal: Open what the exchange refused, and build the request again.

withheld.alreadyAnswered: The payer has already answered this request — there is nothing left to chase or re-ask.
withheld.neverAccepted: The exchange refused this request before the payer saw it, so asking again with the same details would be refused the same way. Fix the request instead.
withheld.notAnswered: Nothing has come back from the payer yet, so there is no approval to withdraw.
withheld.dispensed: This authorization has been dispensed at a till. The service refuses both a retry and a cancellation once it has.
withheld.cancelled: This authorization has already been cancelled.
withheld.notRefused: This request was not refused, so there is no refusal to open.
withheld.reopenNotWiredYet: Reopening a refused request is not available here yet. Use the till application until it is.

results.statusChecked: The exchange answered the status check.
results.statusUnknown: The exchange did not state a status.
results.retriedNoAnswer: The retry did not come back with an answer.
results.cancelNotConfirmed: The cancellation was not confirmed by the payer.

cancel.title: Cancel this authorization
cancel.body: Authorization {{reference}} will be withdrawn with the payer. This cannot be undone.
cancel.noReasons: No cancellation reasons came back, so this authorization cannot be cancelled here. Try again in a moment.
cancel.reasonRequired: Choose a reason first — it is sent to the payer with the cancellation.
cancel.confirmHint: Send the cancellation to the payer.

detail.title: Authorization
detail.subtitle: What was asked, what the payer answered, and what was sent with it.
detail.failureHint: This request was refused before the payer saw it, so there is no verdict to read. Fix the request and raise it again.

lines.none: No lines were recorded on this authorization. A request refused before its lines were built has none.

attachments.none: Nothing was attached to this authorization.

form.title: New authorization
form.subtitle: Everything you do here is recorded on a live request. Leaving discards it — there is nothing to come back to.
form.plant: Priced at store {{plant}}, bound when this request opened and fixed for its life.
form.replayed: This request was already open — your last attempt reached the server, so it was picked up rather than raised a second time.

add.itemNumberPlaceholder: Type or scan an item number

refusal.duplicate: Item {{itemNumber}} is already on this request, on line {{sequence}}. Change that line's quantity instead of adding it again.
refusal.blank: Type an item number to add.
refusal.qty: Ask for a whole quantity of one or more.

insurance.title: Deductible terms
insurance.hint: Inherited from the coverage. Correct a rate, its cap or what has already been paid elsewhere — one change re-prices every line through the engine.

refusal.notANumber: {{group}}: type an amount in the {{field}} — a blank box is not zero.
refusal.rateOutOfRange: {{group}}: a rate is a percentage between 0 and 100.

diagnoses.title: Diagnoses
diagnoses.hint: Search the code list and add what justifies this request. Exactly one diagnosis is the principal one — choosing it here is what makes it so.
diagnoses.searchPlaceholder: Type a code or part of a description
diagnoses.empty: No diagnoses on this request yet. Add the one that justifies it — the first is the principal.

refusal.blank: Choose a diagnosis from the list first.
refusal.duplicate: That diagnosis is already on this request.

morphology.because: A morphology is required because {{code}} — {{description}} is a diagnosis the exchange asks one for.
morphology.searchPlaceholder: Type a morphology code or description
morphology.label: Morphology

diagnoses.exceptionPrescriptionHint: This request takes one item group for all of its items.

attachments.mandatory: At least one attachment is required. The exchange refuses a prior authorization without one, so Submit stays unavailable until you attach the prescription or report that evidences this request.
attachments.duplicatesAllowed: The same document type may be used twice — two prescriptions are two prescriptions. Photos are shrunk before they are sent; PDFs go as they are, up to 5 MB.
attachments.payload: This request will carry {{size}} of attachments.
attachments.previewLabel: Preview of {{fileName}}, exactly as it will be sent

refusal.pdfTooLarge: That PDF is {{size}} and the limit is {{cap}}. Re-scan it at a lower resolution and attach it again.
refusal.unsupportedType: Attach a JPEG, a PNG or a PDF — the exchange takes nothing else.
refusal.unreadable: That file could not be read. Try another copy of it.

blockers.noPrincipal: No diagnosis is marked principal, and the exchange requires exactly one.
blockers.morphologyMissing: The principal diagnosis needs a morphology code — choose one above.
blockers.noAttachment: Nothing is attached, and a prior authorization is refused without at least one document.

lines.empty: Nothing on the request yet. Add the first item above.
lines.selectionReasonGeneric: A generic item carries no selection reason — this is the rule the till has always applied.

capRefusal.notANumber: Type an amount — a blank cap is not the same as no cap.
capRefusal.zeroWillNotApply: A cap of zero will not apply — the engine ignores it. Leave it as it was, or enter the amount you mean.

daysSupplyRefusal.notWhole: Days supply is a whole number of days.
daysSupplyRefusal.outOfRange: Days supply must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.

lines.voidHint: Take this line off the request. It stays on the record as withdrawn.
lines.moneyIsTheEngines: Every amount to the left of Max coverage is the pricing engine's, shown as it was calculated. Yours on this grid are the quantity, the max coverage, the days supply and the selection reason.

leave.warning: Leaving discards this request. Nothing is saved and there is no draft to come back to.

blockers.noEligibility: It was not opened from an eligibility check, so there is nothing to raise it against.
blockers.noCoverage: No policy was chosen, and an authorization is raised under one member ID.
blockers.noActingStore: Your acting store is not resolved yet, and it is what prices this request.

fault.closedTitle: This request is no longer open
fault.closedHint: It has been submitted, abandoned or swept, so nothing more can be added to it.
fault.notYoursTitle: This request belongs to someone else
fault.notYoursHint: Another agent is working this transaction. Start your own from the eligibility.

hardStop.title: This screen is out of date
hardStop.detail: The server answered with contract version {{received}} and this portal speaks {{expected}}. Ask for the portal to be updated rather than working against a version it cannot read.

errors.openTitle: The request could not be opened
errors.openFailed: The request could not be opened.

errors.detailTitle: This authorization could not be opened
errors.detailFailed: The authorization could not be loaded.
errors.listFailed: The authorizations could not be loaded.
errors.providersFailed: The provider list could not be loaded.
errors.selectionReasonsFailed: The selection reasons could not be loaded, so that picker is empty. Everything else on the request still works.
errors.diagnosesFailed: The diagnosis codes could not be searched. Try again in a moment.
errors.morphsFailed: The morphology codes could not be searched. Try again in a moment.
errors.reasonsFailed: The cancellation reasons could not be loaded.
